  const root = document.documentElement;
  const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
  const key = "azpr:theme";
  let preference;
  const readPreference = () => {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(key); } catch { return null; }
  };
  const apply = () => {
    const theme = preference === "light" || preference === "dark"
      ? preference : media.matches ? "dark" : "light";
    root.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
    root.setAttribute("data-mantine-color-scheme", theme);
  };
  preference = readPreference();
  apply();
  try {
    const entries = localStorage.getItem("azpr:home-entries:v1");
    if (entries && entries !== '["hero","pet","weapon","calc"]') root.setAttribute("data-qe", "");
  } catch {}
  media.addEventListener("change", apply);
  window.addEventListener("storage", event => {
    if (event.key !== key && event.key !== null) return;
    preference = readPreference();
    apply();
  });
  window.addEventListener("azpr:theme-preference", event => {
    preference = event.detail;
    try {
      if (preference === "system") localStorage.removeItem(key);
      else localStorage.setItem(key, preference);
    } catch {}
    apply();
  });
